what: Argv text copies validation helpers from design-init-runparams.sh but requires --session-id to be present yet empty
scenario_or_breakage: init-runparams rejects empty session-id via validate_plain_scalar and [[ -n "$SESSION_ID" ]]; copying those helpers makes design-publish.sh exit 2 when SESSION_ID is empty, breaking skip publish/rename and WARN= branches the plan depends on
